MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmed by (1) narrow leadership concentrated in Energy/Materials (top performers concentrated) and (2) widespread weakness across Technology and Financials, so market lacks a clear directional confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) - ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) - ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +4.67% | 1M: +14.66%) - ABOVE TREND. Materials also strong: DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) - ABOVE TREND; PPG (1W: +6.79% | 1M: -15.92%) - RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) - BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) - BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) - BELOW TREND. Financials weak: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) - BELOW TREND; Visa (V) (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -6.69%) - BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) - ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) - ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +25.28%) - ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) - RECOVERY; EOG (1W: +7.81% | 1M: +23.47%) - ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -7.09%) - BELOW TREND; DIS (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -12.44%) - BELOW TREND; LRCX (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -11.46%) - BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -10.11%) - BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -8.59% | 1M: +5.58%) - CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Technology and select Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) - ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) - ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +25.28%) - ABOVE TREND; note multiple RECOVERY setups (FCX, PPG, CEG) where 1W strength contrasts with 1M weakness — this is a MAJOR divergence (≥3 large names) and argues for tactical caution.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is in material weakness: NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) - BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) - BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) - BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -4.56% (24 stocks) and showing broad selling; watch for stabilization rather than rotation into tech today.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft with limited leadership: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) - BELOW TREND; V (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -6.69%) - BELOW TREND; MA (1W: -2.43% | 1M: -5.93%) - BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -1.46% (20 stocks) and not confirming risk-on.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed with defensive pockets and some recoveries: JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) - RECOVERY; UNH (1W: -6.01% | 1M: -8.94%) - BELOW TREND; LLY (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -14.07%) - BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -0.69% (17 stocks) — watch FDA-driven names for idiosyncratic moves.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Materials exposure given ABOVE TREND leaders, reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names that remain BELOW TREND, and monitor RECOVERY names (AAPL, FCX, JNJ) for confirmation before rotating. Style: Value/Cyclical favored in the short run but leadership is narrow — remain selective.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) - ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) - ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) - ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) - BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) - BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -7.09%) - BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +17.83%) — monitor continuation of ABOVE TREND leaders. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.56% | 1M: -7.18%) and Financials (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -9.37%) — watch for further downside or stabilization.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch behavioral triggers: SLB — sustain weekly follow-through to confirm ABOVE TREND extension; XOM — hold 1M strength to validate sector leadership; AAPL (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -8.85%) - RECOVERY — needs follow-through above its 1M mean to signal durable turn; META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) - BELOW TREND — continued breakdown would signal further downside risk.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (+50): Microsoft AI partnerships headline but price MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) - BELOW TREND; sentiment vs price is a divergence (bullish news, price falling). LLY (+55): Eli Lilly deal headline while LLY (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -14.07%) - BELOW TREND; bullish headlines not yet reflected in price (divergence), monitor for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (-80): lawsuit headline and GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) - BELOW TREND; sentiment confirming price weakness. META (-80): same headline and META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) - BELOW TREND; sentiment and price both confirm elevated downside risk. PANW (-50): PANW (1W: -9.78% | 1M: -1.59%) - BELOW TREND; bearish news aligns with sharp weekly drawdown.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL regime, Value/Cyclical style favored but leadership is narrow (Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive). XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) - ABOVE TREND and SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) - ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence with multiple large-cap techs BELOW TREND while select names (MSFT, LLY) carry bullish headlines but lack price confirmation — monitor for trend breaks.
